# Peel UI (v0.2.0)

> Open-source registry of 120fps tactile React primitives crafted with Motion, GSAP, and Tailwind CSS.
> Repository: https://github.com/killersumit/peel-ui
> Website: https://peel-ui.vercel.app

## Overview

Peel UI provides physics-based, tactile component primitives designed with concentric squircle geometry, machined dark surfaces, and critically damped compositor springs. All primitives are 100% free under the MIT License and compatible with the shadcn CLI registry pattern.

## Installation

Install components into your project using the shadcn CLI:

```bash
# Add a single component
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/<slug>.json

# Example: Slide to Confirm
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/slide-to-confirm.json
```

## Component Primitives Directory

### 1. Morphing Share Island
- **Slug**: `morphing-share-island`
- **URL**: https://peel-ui.vercel.app/components/morphing-share-island
- **Description**: A compact share pill that spring-morphs into a 4-action radial dock and collapses into a confirmed state.
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/morphing-share-island.json`
